Domestic supply evidence: NOT established. GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tenders and annual-report India-vs-export splits could not be retrieved — DuckDuckGo search backend was down (connection refused on all queries), company website prakashchemicals.com returned HTTP 500, and thecompanycheck.com returned HTTP 403. Revenue and domestic turnover therefore recorded as null rather than estimated. No claim of domestic supply is made either way; status left 'unknown', not 'confirmed'.
